newsitem.title: UK: Two Brent cargoes kept, third clocked - trade.
newsitem.headline: Two Brent cargoes kept, third clocked - trade.

text.p: Two of the three Brent cargoes nominated from the paper chains on Tuesday were kept ahead of the five o'clock deadline but the third was clocked, traders said.
Phibro and Vitol kept two of the cargoes assigned March 26-28 loading dates while U.S. refiner Chevron was clocked, they said.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
